Works Well, a Little Messy - I love my Keurig for how quickly I can make a single cup of coffee. I hate disposable K-cups because of how expensive they are and how much waste they create. I started by using the Keurig My K-Cup, which works well, but they're pretty expensive.

These refillable K-cup replacements work very well. Unlike the My K-Cup, you don't have to remove the k-cup holder to use these refillable cups. They hold plenty of coffee grounds for a single cup of coffee. I actually fill these all the way with grounds, then run the largest size and run it again on the smallest size with the same grounds. This fills my travel mugs nicely and the coffee tastes just right.

I'm not sure if these are officially dishwasher safe or not, but I wash them in my dishwasher and haven't had any problems. Just make sure they don't fall through the tray and rest against your drying element. The only problem I've had with these is they have quite a bit of water/coffee on top of them after they are done brewing. This makes a little bit of a mess inside the brewer when it take them out. It's really a small problem, but enough that I took them from five stars to four. I have other refillable k-cups that don't have the same problem.

Make sure you know how this machine works before purchasing. - If you have a look around Amazon, you will see that there are lots… And lots… And lots of these icemakers listed by Chinese companies on Amazon right now. Some of them look a little different from each other, but they all basically work the same. As long as you have the right expectations, they work very well. But if your expectations are too high, you will be very disappointed.

Some of the basic things you need to know about this icemaker… First of all, it is not connected to a water source. You pour water into the reservoir. Next, the ice is not kept frozen inside. The machine will make ice until the bin is full. Then the ice will melt, if not removed from the bin, and will be recycled again and again and again. Freezing… Melting… Freezing… Melting… And so on. For this reason, you really need to turn it off at night when you’re sleeping or when you leave the office, if you are using it in an office environment.

When the bin is full, which takes about an hour, you will have enough ice to fill a 32 ounce water bottle. Though the listing shows that it will make 26 pounds of ice within twenty-four hours, that is only possible if someone is going to remove the ice each time the bin is full… Day and night. If you want to make ice and save it, then you will need to place it into your own freezer. But keep in mind that the ice will be “wet” so when you place it into your own freezer it will freeze together and you will need to break it apart to use it.

This icemaker is made in China and being sold by Chinese company on Amazon.

I went to Home Depot and the narrowest connector they had was 1/4 inch, but it could take two wires, so I used one of those.
